(b)
parts.text:
Samples of $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ are reacted separately with an excess of solution **A** and with an excess of solution **B**.

The reaction of $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ with solution **A** is a precipitation reaction.

The reaction of $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ with solution **B** is a ligand substitution reaction.

Suggest a possible identity for solution **A** and for solution **B**. Give relevant observations and the formula of the copper-containing product for each reaction.
